title: Diffusion Tree Sampling for Inference Time Adaptation of Crystal Generative Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.17462v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion-based generative models have become strong priors over plausible crystal structures, but turning that prior into promising candidates requires steering toward several conflicting properties at once. Fine-tuning is expensive and produces a new model for every new objective, while differentiable guidance is not applicable to many real-world tasks. We instead adapt these generative models at inference time using Diffusion Tree Sampling (DTS), a Monte Carlo tree search procedure over the denoising trajectory. We make two technical contributions on top of DTS that are particularly relevant for AI-for-science applications. First, we show how to use existing property-conditional generative models (e.g., models fine-tuned for classifier-free guidance) as guided proposals inside DTS, without distorting the target distribution. translated_title: 面向晶体生成模型推理时自适应的扩散树采样方法
translated_abstract: 基于扩散的生成模型已成为对合理晶体结构的强大先验，但要将这一先验转化为有前景的候选材料，需要同时向多个相互冲突的性质进行引导。微调成本高昂，且每引入一个新目标都需要训练一个新模型；而可微引导方法又不适用于许多现实世界的任务。我们转而在推理阶段通过扩散树采样来适配这些生成模型，这是一种作用于去噪轨迹上的蒙特卡洛树搜索方法。我们在DTS基础上做出了两项与AI-for-科学应用尤其相关的技术贡献。第一，我们展示了如何将现有的性质条件生成模型（例如为无分类器引导而微调的模型）作为DTS内部的引导性提议分布加以利用，且不会扭曲目标分布。第二，我们将DTS扩展到多目标采样，使得单次搜索即可产生覆盖整个……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出扩散树采样（DTS）方法，通过在去噪轨迹上进行蒙特卡洛树搜索，在推理阶段引导晶体扩散生成模型，既能直接复用现有性质条件模型而不扭曲目标分布，又支持多目标采样以高效生成满足多个冲突性质的晶体候选。
en_tdlr: Proposes Diffusion Tree Sampling (DTS), a Monte Carlo tree search over the denoising trajectory that adapts diffusion-based crystal generative models at inference time, reusing existing property-conditional models without distorting the target distribution and extending to multi-objective sampling.
